name: Flux Foundry Canonical Reference
purpose: Durable compatibility canary for Foundry-supported application patterns. Intentionally boring platform verification — not product UX.
ownership: Foundry-owned fixture. Documents and validates the template app as the reference subject; do not fork this into a second product app.

capabilities.summary: Authenticated dashboard requires session; unauthenticated access fails closed.
Explicit public routes (/ , /login) vs protected dashboard tree.
RLS policies bind rows to jwt.sub = user_id.
Notes and record_tags require owning parent records row.
Create/read/update/archive via server actions; archive sets status + archived_at.
Mutations go through server actions + lib/flux; only Auth.js API route.
Zod validation and actionError sanitize Unauthorized/Flux/generic failures.
Required security migrations and centralized invariants pass.
.env.example documents required secrets without browser Flux credentials.
No NEXT_PUBLIC_FLUX_* or raw Flux fetches outside lib/flux/client.ts.
foundry.baseline.json present; status current; reference baselineVersion matches.
Authenticated gateway bridge probe against a real Flux endpoint.
Unauthenticated gateway fail-closed semantics for tenant data.
capabilities.pendingReason: Flux-core / gateway contract — Foundry must not invent or fake unauth gateway behavior.
